criteria: current verdict is incomplete; zero tests/stale review do not pass
one writer and confirmed W1 termination/freeze before ownership transfer
dispatch includes objective, allowed paths, source state and exclusions
worker return requires artifact pointers, tested state, command/result/coverage and unresolved work
review gets canonical criteria and actual frozen artifacts, independently checks refresh or marks unverified
integration decision checks current combined state; no passing from stale C0 review
unknown listener/data preserved; new owned instance and cleanup retain evidence

method: Five independent control responses before skill authoring; five fresh responses with skill afterward. Manual per-criterion inspection. Paper probes assess instruction use, not real tool execution or statistical effectiveness.
